request.prompt: Edit the attached original game foliage texture into a softer hand-painted fantasy MMORPG evergreen bough texture. Keep the same overall branch arrangement, square framing, macro silhouette, generous empty transparent upper area, and hanging branch tips. Paint foliage as broad readable groups of pointed green leaf scales and needles, with chunky clustered light planes, subdued fine detail and brush-shaped edges. Warm olive green sunlit tops, muted dark moss green undersides, gentle teal-green depth. Create cohesive painted forms instead of photorealistic individual needle filaments; do not merely blur the image. It must remain a flat diffuse game texture with transparent organic outer edges. No trunk, whole tree, ground, cast shadow, sky, letters, border, UI, black or colored background, scenery, or new objects. Preserve transparency. Keep all foliage inside the canvas; no clipped branch tips. This is an original Astraeon foliage asset, not copied from any game artwork.

validation: Original output inspected; dimensions/alpha/lossless pixels verified; native/runtime adoption and visual acceptance pending
